description: Land Acquisition - Yodagama, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: The gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring specific parcels of land needed for public purpose. It provides detailed descriptions of land allotments, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in his capacity as the authority making the land acquisition declaration, not as a personnel matter. The core content is exclusively about land matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
